newsitem.title: SAUDI ARABIA: Saudi beheads four murderers, one drug smuggler.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads four murderers, one drug smuggler.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded four Saudi murderers and one drug smuggler, the Saudi Interior Ministry said.

A ministry statement carried on state-run television said the four, all relatives from the Otaibi tribe, were executed in Mecca after being found guilty of beating to death a Saudi man with an iron wire after stealing his money.
"The four men took the victim to the desert, and after they consumed alcohol (banned in Islam) and drugs, they took turns beating him on his head with the wire until he died," it said.
A fifth Saudi man was beheaded in the city of Tabuk after a court found him guilty of smuggling heroin and hashish into the kingdom, it added.
The beheadings raised to 16 the number of people executed in the conservative Islamic kingdom so far this year. On Sunday, it beheaded five Nigerians for armed robbery in Mecca.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
